subject: Complaint regarding Phishing/KYC Scam via suspicious link
body:
To,
The Cyber Cell,
National Cybercrime Reporting Portal,

I am writing to report a Phishing/KYC Scam that occurred on [Date and time of incident]. 

Summary of Incident:
[Describe what happened in your words]

Scam Type: Phishing/KYC Scam

Suspicious Details:
URL: http://bit.ly/sbi-kyc-upd8

Red Flags Identified:
- Urgency (account will be BLOCKED today)
- Shortened URL (bit.ly)
- Generic greeting (Dear Customer)
- URL shortener hides the real link (bit.ly)
- Link is not secure (http): bit.ly
- Urgency / threat words (pressure to act fast)
- KYC update request
- KYC update with a link (classic bank-KYC scam)

Loss Details:
Amount Lost: [Amount lost, if any]
Payment Method: [Payment method, e.g. UPI / card / bank transfer]
Transaction ID: [Transaction ID / UTR, if any]

I request you to kindly take immediate action to block the mentioned URL(s) and to freeze the beneficiary bank account(s) associated with this fraudulent activity to prevent further scams.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
[Your phone number]
